claims.source_quote_ar: وَقِيلَ: فِي مَوْضِعِ نَصْبٍ بَدَلًا مِنْ «مَا» ؛ أَيْ: بِئْسَ شَيْئًا سَخِطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ. وَقِيلَ: هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعِ جَرٍّ بِلَامٍ مَحْذُوفَةٍ؛ أَيْ: لِأَنْ سَخِطَ.
claims.claim_ar: اختلاف في إعراب «شَيْئًا»: قِيلَ إنه منصوب بَدَلٌ من «مَا»، وقِيلَ إنه في موضع جرٍ بلامٍ محذوفة (أي: لِأَنَّ سَخِطَ).
claims.claim_en: There is a grammatical disagreement about the word 'شَيْئًا': one view renders it accusative as a bad-thing 'بدل' (in place of 'ما'), while another view takes it as genitive governed by an omitted lām (i.e., with the sense 'لِأَنْ سَخِطَ').
claims.needs_review_reason: This is an explicit alternate analysis reported by the commentary; context of the verse should be reviewed to choose between the options.

claims.claim_en: The preposition 'إِلَى' may be attached to an omitted verb (i.e., 'إِلَيْكُمْ' could relate to an unexpressed verb in the context).
